2. Issue notice before admission to the respondents, returnable on 6-5-2024.
3.
Shri S.M. Ukey, learned Additional Government Pleader, waives service of notice for the respondents.
4. The perusal of the Award dated 24-12-2004 issued under the provisions of the Land Acqauisition Act, 1894 depicts that the land survey No.43 to the extent of 1.44 Hectare came to be acquired.

5. It is the case of the petitioners that in addition to 1.44 Hectare, the respondents have taken possession of the petitioners' land to the extent of 0.85 Hectare without giving any compensation to the petitioners.

sentences.text: 1 6 . As such, we expect the respondents, particularly the respondent No.2, to make a categorical statement by filing an affidavit as to whether the area of 0.85 Hectare for which the petitioners are claiming compensation is included in the total area acquired, i.e. 1.44 Hectare.
Such affidavit be filed by the returnable date.
(ABHAY J. MANTRI, J.) (NITIN W. SAMBRE, J.) LANJEWAR
